title: Baraguj Szuul mouth event
summary: Fight through the mouth gauntlet, defeat an Unimaginable Horror, then confront the returned Baraguj Szuul.
overview: Fight through the mouth gauntlet, defeat an Unimaginable Horror, then confront the returned Baraguj Szuul.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The mouth event populates a descending gauntlet of enemies ending in an Unimaginable Horror.
Defeating the Horror casts Dimensional Return on players within two hundred units and replaces the waiting Baraguj with the combat version.
Regroup after the return before fighting Baraguj. His triggered form begins checking for an idle reset after fifteen minutes.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.

Confirm the entry trigger and spawn wiring for legacy mouth_trigger.pl before publication. The completion chain from the Horror to Baraguj is present, but no reviewed source caller starts that Perl gauntlet.
